manualSteps.label: Workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated workspace and click Workflows.

manualSteps.label: Saved process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflow files, Open workflow, then printed-replacement-part-common-digital-083.workflow.wflow.

manualSteps.label: Common view
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process. Inspect the original inputs and any readiness reason.

manualSteps.label: Run
manualSteps.instruction: Click Prepare and check inputs, then Start process. Inspect the recorded digital results; reload to reconcile the same run.

steps.label: Enter the workspace workflow editor
steps.summary: The existing workflow editor opens in the workspace.
steps.purpose: Normal workspace entry preserves the workflow editor
steps.expected: Normal workspace entry preserves the workflow editor
steps.actual: The existing workflow editor opens in the workspace.

steps.label: Open the supported saved digital process
steps.summary: The mesh preparation process is open; its two configured provider operations are preserved.
steps.purpose: The exact two-stage accepted source opens
steps.expected: The exact two-stage accepted source opens
steps.actual: The mesh preparation process is open; its two configured provider operations are preserved.

steps.label: Use the common working view
steps.summary: The shared common working view opens in a Wright workspace tab.
steps.actual: The shared common working view opens in a Wright workspace tab.

steps.label: Check normal readiness
steps.summary: The configured native arguments and exact upstream-file dependency pass public readiness. No integration policy is used.
steps.purpose: Ordinary public readiness permits this bounded saved process
steps.expected: Ordinary public readiness permits this bounded saved process
steps.actual: The configured native arguments and exact upstream-file dependency pass public readiness. No integration policy is used.

steps.label: Start from the common view
steps.summary: The normal UI receives one accepted run 8c042141e6c7422aa58ca1bbab14d86e; the common view follows backend-owned progress without a generated interface.
steps.purpose: One durable digital run is accepted by the backend
steps.expected: One durable digital run is accepted by the backend
